name: Proxmox Backup Orchestrator
description: Rotating external-disk backups for Proxmox VE + Proxmox Backup Server: detects a USB disk on the host, passes it through to the PBS VM, prepares a removable PBS datastore, syncs the backups to it and ejects it safely. Includes planning, notifications and an iCalendar feed.

notes.text: Open https://<container-ip> after the install to create the admin account (self-signed certificate).
USB passthrough needs an agent on the Proxmox VE host: the app shows a one-line install command (Agents > Add).
Proxmox Backup Server 3.3 or newer is required (removable datastores).
AUTH_SECRET_KEY in /etc/pbo/pbo.env encrypts the secrets stored in the database: never change it.
